description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rules of Exchange Effective from 14.01.2019 to 20.01.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
